title: Sunday Quick Tip
subtitle: Say what to do
hook: Listen to your next correction. Does it start with don't?
statement: Kids follow pictures of what to do.
q1: Do you phrase corrections as what to try —
q2: or name the mistake so it is clear?
q3: What picture does your words put in their head?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But players respond faster
t2: when they hear what to do next.
cta: Coaches — how do you word corrections?
ctaLines: Find space. Stay wide. Eyes up.
Try this or don't do that?
ctaPrompt: Share your coaching words below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Listen to your next correction. Does it start with don't?
You say don't bunch up. Kids hear bunch up.
Kids follow pictures of what to do.
Say what to do or name the mistake. Every team is different.
How do you word corrections? Share your habit in the comments.
